import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import Job, find_deficient_cut, compile_plan, check_plan, cut_value
from miniflow import FlowNet

def min_cut_value(job):
    """minimum over valid S of cap(S)+D-dem(S); deficient iff < D"""
    C=job.C; n=job.n; D=job.D
    ss,tt=n,n+1
    base=D+1+sum(job.c)
    BIG=base*(D+1)+1
    best=None
    for a in C:
        for b in C:
            if a==b: continue
            net=FlowNet(n+2)
            for l,(u,v,_c) in enumerate(job.links):
                w=job.c[l]
                if w>0:
                    net.add(u,v,w); net.add(v,u,w)
            for x in C:
                if job.demands[x]>0: net.add(ss,x,job.demands[x])
            net.add(ss,a,BIG); net.add(b,tt,BIG)
            val=net.maxflow(ss,tt)
            if best is None or val<best: best=val
    return best

rng = random.Random(202)
stats={'tight':0,'plan_fail':0,'ok':0,'slow':0}
fails=[]
tstart=time.monotonic()
for trial in range(150):
    n = rng.randint(3, 9)
    used=set(); links=[]
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 18)):
        u=rng.randrange(n); v=rng.randrange(n)
        if u==v: continue
        k=(min(u,v),max(u,v))
        if k in used: continue
        used.add(k); links.append((u,v,rng.randint(1,8)))
    if not links: continue
    k = rng.randint(2, min(n, 8))
    ps = sorted(rng.sample(range(n), k))
    demands={v: rng.randint(0,6) for v in ps}
    if sum(demands.values())==0: continue
    env={l: rng.randint(1,8) for l in range(len(links)) if rng.random()<0.9}
    if not env: continue
    p=1
    job=Job(n,links,demands,p,env)
    if find_deficient_cut(job) is not None: continue
    mc=min_cut_value(job)
    tight = (mc == job.D)
    if tight: stats['tight']+=1
    t0=time.monotonic()
    plan=compile_plan(job, budget=6)
    dt=time.monotonic()-t0
    if dt>3: stats['slow']+=1
    if plan is None or not check_plan(job,plan):
        stats['plan_fail']+=1
        fails.append((n,links,demands,p,env,tight,dt))
    else:
        stats['ok']+=1
print(stats, 'elapsed', round(time.monotonic()-tstart,1))
for f in fails[:8]: print(f)
